services.desc: Want to fly like a bird? There’s no better feeling than soaring amongst eagles and hawks. Our sponsor companies on this page are private organizations that provide lessons and tandem flights. They are all run by members in good standing with the West Coast Soaring Club, and as such, they are certified HPAC Instructors. This also means they carry HPAC insurance. Our sponsors operate independently from the West Coast Soaring Club. We are not responsible for any arrangement, services, or goods you may obtain from them. Our sponsor links on this page will take you to our sponsor’s websites. We do not vouch for the content or security of any of our sponsor’s sites. Come join us for our annual

blurb: The club supports free flight pilots by securing access to launches and landing zones, maintaining flying sites, providing training opportunities like reserve repack clinics, and organizing events and competitions. It connects pilots regionally and internationally and offers mentorship for all skill levels. The club itself does not offer tandem flights or instruction but has sponsor members who do.
